Too many property choices are represented by crowded cards plus an overload warning badge.
A selected sheet, checklist, and drawback badge turn noisy cards into a readable curation proxy.
Two document panels and a recommendation ribbon make the proxy feel document-backed rather than a generic strategy diagram.
An abstract AI panel, confidence bars, and matched property card are visible without real product branding.
Boundary, inheritance, and neighborhood risks are separated into visible warning markers around a property context card.
